notes: Owner-only Crypto tab next to Financial Literacy within Finance, hidden from Diana.
Read-only Bybit API key/secret connection encrypted at rest; rejects keys with write permission.
Public-address Ethereum integration for native ETH, USDT, USDC and WETH spot balances; blocks erroneous balance overwrite if onchain Uniswap v3/v4 LP NFTs are found.
Connect or disconnect previously created finance wallets; auto-sync every 10 minutes while the finance page is open and refresh manually.
Convert remote USD equity to each existing wallet's native RUDI currency without creating income or expense transactions; preserve old balances on provider errors.
Separate server-side connection storage, no API credentials in client responses, no new cron or functions.
Pending production release: prepared on feature branch only. Deployment requires explicit user confirmation.
versionPolicy: Крупное обновление: следующий целый номер. Мелкое обновление: следующий десятичный номер. Один пакет изменений = один production deploy.
